notes:
**New**

- **iPad References show real reference cards.** The iPad References sidebar no longer lists bare one-line snippets (and, for a tag or body-less note, a flat list of dates) — each reference now shows the linking block with its breadcrumb and one or two levels of its children, the way the desktop backlinks panel does. Read-only for now; inline editing follows. (PRD §A1; #979.)

**Fixes & polish**

- **Find in note opens in the right place on desktop.** ⌘F's find bar now sits at the top-right of the note, its intended spot — instead of drifting to the top-left over empty space with the note pushed to one side. (PRD Addendum 38 §AD3.1; #1000.)
- **No more phantom menus while scrolling on iPad.** Scrolling with the Magic Keyboard trackpad — a two-finger stop, a direction reversal, a two-finger-then-one nudge — no longer pops the block menu (Copy block reference / Turn into…) *or* the system text callout (Paste · AutoFill · Ask Siri) by mistake. A right-click at rest still opens the block menu exactly as before, and Copy/Paste come right back the moment scrolling stops. (#980.)
- **Smoother Settings on iPad.** Switching sections in Settings on iPad now changes instantly, like the desktop, instead of sliding a faint ghost of the old pane across the list — and closing Settings fades the card away instead of flinging it off the screen edge. On iPhone the slide is unchanged. (D-12 R4 D-erratum; #982.)
